consequence.statement: Strimzi 0.46.0 no longer supports ZooKeeper-based clusters or ZooKeeper-to-KRaft migration, so any cluster still on ZooKeeper must be moved to KRaft before upgrading to 0.46.0 or newer.
consequence.remediation: Migrate every cluster to KRaft while still on a Strimzi release older than 0.46.0, then upgrade.

assertion.statement: Strimzi 0.46.0 removes support for ZooKeeper-based Kafka clusters and for migrating them to KRaft, so every cluster must already use KRaft before the upgrade to 0.46.0.
